messages:
Ravi: quick sync 1: we've seen a few autoscaler oscillation blips on dedicated pools after the headroom patch. amplitude small but noisy for low-latency tenants.
Elaine: can you paste an example timeline? was it thrash (scale up then immediate scale down) or repeated small bounces?
Ravi: mostly thrash on cold-starts + burst drains. timeline:
```
[2026-03-23T09:02:10Z] metric: queue_depth -> spike
[2026-03-23T09:02:12Z] autoscaler: scale_up +3 nodes
[2026-03-23T09:02:18Z] workloads finish, queue empty
[2026-03-23T09:02:22Z] autoscaler: scale_down -3 nodes
[2026-03-23T09:02:25Z] metric: new spike -> repeat
```
Tom: sounds like the hysteresis window is too tight for short-lived bursts. current down_hysteresis_sec is 30s, maybe increase to 60-90s for bursty tenants.
Priya: increasing global hysteresis helps but hurts utilization. propose we add tenant-class dampening: premium tenants get longer down-delay to avoid p99 regressions, best-effort tenants keep short down-delay to reclaim capacity.
Marta: +1. also suggest shard-aware scaling: when a single shard triggers scale up, annotate it and avoid full-pool scale-down until all shards cool. reduces churn from localized bursts.
Ravi: good idea. sketch config:
```
autoscaler.down_hysteresis.default = 30s
autoscaler.down_hysteresis.premium = 90s
autoscaler.shard_cooldown_sec = 45s
autoscaler.tenant_dampening.enabled = true
```
OpsBot: note: will need telemetry events: scale_decision_origin, shard_annotation, tenant_dampening_applied.
Elaine: important tradeoff: longer hysteresis increases cold-start risk for new, sudden sustained load. we should add a fastpath: if sustained queue depth > threshold for M seconds, bypass down-hysteresis and keep nodes. basically asymmetric thresholds for up vs down.
Tom: agree. up path stays sensitive, down path gets conservative per tenant/shard. also add an oscillation detector: if scale events > N in T window, enable exponential backoff on further scale-downs.
Priya: add metrics: oscillation_count, avg_time_between_scales, wasted_cycles. plan: canary these knobs on stage with 2 synthetic noisy tenants and 10 small tenants.
Marta: timeline: I'll open a tiny RFC for the damping + shard annotation, Ravi can PR config + metrics, then stage canary next week.
Ravi: thanks. PR coming today for metrics + basic damping. leaving thread open for comments. :rocket:
